lines: Main khayal hoon kisi aur ka, mujhe sochta koi aur hai.
couplets.en: I am one person's thought, yet someone else thinks of me.

lines: Main khayal hoon kisi aur ka, mujhe sochta koi aur hai.
couplets.en: I am one person's thought, yet someone else thinks of me.

lines: Main kisi ke dast-e-talab mein hoon, to kisi ke harf-e-dua mein hoon.
couplets.en: One hand reaches for me, and someone else speaks of me in prayer.

lines: To kisi ke harf-e-dua mein hoon.
Main naseeb hoon kisi aur ka, mujhe maangta koi aur hai.
couplets.en: I am in someone's prayer, one person's lot and another's wish.

lines: Main naseeb hoon kisi aur ka, mujhe maangta koi aur hai.
couplets.en: I am one person's lot, yet someone else asks for me.

lines: Ajab aitbaar aur be-aitbaari ke darmiyaan hai zindagi.
couplets.en: Strangely, life hangs between trust and mistrust.

lines: Main qareeb hoon kisi aur ke, mujhe jaanta koi aur hai.
couplets.en: I am close to one person, yet someone else knows me.

lines: Tujhe dushmanon ki khabar na thi, mujhe doston ka pata nahin.
couplets.en: You knew nothing of your enemies, and I do not know where my friends are.

lines: Teri dastaan koi aur thi, mera waqia koi aur hai.
couplets.en: Yours was one story, and what happened to me is another.

lines: Jo meri riyazat-e-neem-shab ko, Saleem, subh na mil saki.
couplets.en: If my midnight devotions never found their dawn, Saleem.

lines: Jo meri riyazat-e-neem-shab ko, Saleem, subh na mil saki.
To phir is ke maani to ye hue, ke yahaan Khuda koi aur hai.
couplets.en: If my midnight devotions never found their dawn, Saleem, then the God of this place must be someone else.

lines: Is ke maani to ye hue, ke yahaan Khuda koi aur hai.
couplets.en: It can only mean that the God of this place is someone else.
